name: Noxious Saliva (Combat, Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kineticist 7, virulent blast, Komodo’s Bite, bite attack.

Benefit(s): Once per day, when a creature fails its save against your Komodo’s Bite, you can accept 1 point of burn as an immediate action to instead cause the creature to become nauseated for the same duration, then sickened for the same number of rounds. This is a poison effect.
